MeasureTheory.estimate_trnc₁.statement: Let $t \in (0,1)$, $p_0, q_0, p_1, q_1 > 0$, and write $\mathrm{sel}\ j$ for the selection of the $j$-indexed exponent. Assume $\mathrm{sel}\ j\ p_0\ p_1 \le \mathrm{sel}\ j\ q_0\ q_1$, both of these are finite, $p_0 < p_1$, $q_0 \ne q_1$, $p^{-1} = (1-t)p_0^{-1} + t p_1^{-1}$, $q^{-1} = (1-t)q_0^{-1} + t q_1^{-1}$, $f$ is $\mu$-a.e. strongly measurable, $\mu$ restricted to the support of $\|f\|$ is $\sigma$-finite, and the exponent $\mathrm{spf}.\sigma$ of the scaled power function $\mathrm{spf}$ equals $\zeta(p_0, q_0, p_1, q_1, t)$. Then the integral $\int_0^\infty \|\mathrm{trnc}_j(f, \mathrm{ton}(s))\|_{L^{\mathrm{sel}\,j\,p_0\,p_1}(\mu)}^{\mathrm{sel}\,j\,q_0\,q_1} \cdot s^{(q \ldots)}\, ds$ (where $\mathrm{ton}$ is the truncation scale determined by $\mathrm{spf}$) is bounded by an explicit expression; the rest of the statement is truncated in the source.
MeasureTheory.estimate_trnc₁.sketch: Apply `estimate_trnc` with the particular exponent $\sigma = \zeta(p_0, q_0, p_1, q_1, t)$, checking its hypotheses (the ordering of $q_0$ relative to $q$ and positivity of $q_0 + \sigma^{-1}(q - q_0)$) via identities for $\zeta$.

MeasureTheory.estimate_trnc.statement: Let $p_0, q_0 > 0$ with $p_0 \le q_0$, let $f$ be $\mu$-a.e. strongly measurable with $\mu$ restricted to the support of $\|f\|$ $\sigma$-finite, suppose $q_0 < q$ if $j \oplus \mathrm{mon} = \mathrm{true}$ (where $\mathrm{mon}$ is the monotonicity flag of the truncation scale of $\mathrm{spf}$) and $q < q_0$ otherwise, and suppose $0 < q_0 + \mathrm{spf}.\sigma^{-1}(q - q_0)$. Then $$\int_0^\infty \|\mathrm{trnc}_j(f, \mathrm{ton}(s))\|_{L^{p_0}(\mu)}^{q_0}\, s^{q - q_0 - 1}\, ds \le \mathrm{spf}.d^{\,q - q_0}\, |q - q_0|^{-1} \Big(\int_{\{\|f\| \ne 0\}} \|f(a)\|^{p_0 + \mathrm{spf}.\sigma^{-1}(q - q_0)(p_0/q_0)}\, d\mu(a)\Big)^{q_0/p_0},$$ where $\mathrm{ton}$ is the truncation scale determined by $\mathrm{spf}$.
MeasureTheory.estimate_trnc.sketch: No named results are used; the proof is a direct computation with the truncations and extended nonnegative real arithmetic.
